description: Suspends a Lovie account: it keeps its balance and stays open at the sponsor bank, but Lovie refuses to send money from it FROM NOW ON. It does not recall payments already on their way, and it does not close the account - say both of those before you call this. Set account_id to the id of the account to freeze - get it from list_accounts, never from the conversation alone, and name the account and its current status back to the user first, because freezing the wrong account stops a company paying. Safe to repeat: an account that is already frozen is returned unchanged and successfully. A closed account is rejected, and so is a linked account. Only report an account as frozen when the call succeeded - an error means it is still live. Requires the banking.account.freeze permission; a viewer or accountant is refused.
name: account_freeze_account
title: Freeze Account
